d7c96daab35e1af99f4abf39fac256296487b4b8.summary: Jamf Threat Labs describes 14 trojanized macOS disk images and installer packages impersonating known Mac apps. The samples are unsigned and run a multi-stage download chain ending in OtterCookie, a malware family the report links to the Contagious Interview campaign. The report says Contagious Interview is attributed to the DPRK and that the chain reuses earlier fake job-interview delivery methods such as Git hooks and VS Code tasks. The samples do not execute by default, which the report suggests may mean active testing or early development.
